subject: english
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

The study led

P. collaborators from Bristol, Cambridge and Germany

Q. by scientists at the University of Bath and including

R. used fossils and analysed genetic differences between

S. modern snakes to reconstruct snake evolution
solution:
Here the correct answer is **QPRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence to form a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence is: QPRS.
 
• The sentence can be rearranged as follows:
 
 
• The study led
 
• **Q.** by scientists at the University of Bath and including
 
• **P. **collaborators from Bristol, Cambridge and Germany
 
• **R.** used fossils and analysed genetic differences between
 
• **S.** modern snakes to reconstruct snake evolution
 
 
 
• This sequence forms a coherent sentence that describes the study conducted by scientists to reconstruct snake evolution.
 
• It begins with the mention of the study being led **(Q)**, followed by the information about the scientists involved, which includes collaborators from Bristol, Cambridge, and Germany **(P)**.
 
• Then, it continues by mentioning the methods used in the study, which involved analyzing genetic differences between modern snakes and using fossils **(R)**.
 
• Finally, it concludes the sentence by stating the purpose of the study, which was to reconstruct snake evolution **(S).**
